title: Refactor apply should use hash-bound apply tokens instead of bare confirm booleans
wanted_capability: A two-phase apply flow where dry-run plan returns an apply token bound to plan hash, file hashes, touched paths, dirty-worktree state, operator opt-outs, and expiry; apply consumes the token rather than accepting confirm=true plus repeated large plan payloads.
fallback_used: Relied on bbox_refactor_apply(confirm=true) semantics and plan hash checks.
notes: confirm=true is easy for isolate code to pass accidentally; a token makes the approval boundary and exact reviewed artifact explicit.
